issues.explanation: The requirement does not specify the actor (the system or module responsible for outputting the temperatures) or the trigger/condition (when or how frequently the temperatures should be output).

questions.question_text: Regarding the phrase "shall be output for subsequent processing", which system or component is responsible for outputting the valid temperatures, and under what conditions, triggers, or frequency should they be output?

answers.answer_text: the Determine Temperature Status process (SRS-009) outputs the temperature status to Determine H/C Mode (SRS-010), whenever a reported temperature or changed setting falls within the overtemperature bounds LO = TSET - OD and UO = TSET + OD. No frequency is specified -- the document is event-driven, and the trigger is the arrival of a temperature value or a setting change.

test_strategy.rationale: The requirement specifies explicit mathematical bounds and thresholds for temperature (LO = TSET - OD and UO = TSET + OD). Following the guidance for numeric ranges and thresholds, Equivalence Partitioning is selected to partition temperature values into inside/outside valid ranges, and Boundary Value Analysis is selected to test exact boundary conditions around LO and UO.

test_cases.title: Reported temperature within overtemperature bounds
test_cases.preconditions: Initialization file sets TSET = 70.0 and OD = 5.0 (LO = 65.0, UO = 75.0) per SRS-005. System is in normal operation mode.
steps: 1. Report a temperature value of 70.0 degrees (midpoint between LO and UO).
2. Observe the message output from the Determine Temperature Status process (SRS-009).
test_cases.expected_result: The Determine Temperature Status process (SRS-009) detects the temperature is within overtemperature bounds [65.0, 75.0] and outputs the temperature status to Determine H/C Mode (SRS-010).

test_cases.title: Changed temperature setting causes current temperature to fall within overtemperature bounds
test_cases.preconditions: Initialization file configures OD = 5.0. Initial TSET = 80.0 (LO = 75.0, UO = 85.0). Reported temperature is 70.0 degrees (outside current bounds).
steps: 1. Update the temperature setting TSET to 70.0 degrees, adjusting LO to 65.0 and UO to 75.0.
2. Observe the response of the Determine Temperature Status process (SRS-009).
test_cases.expected_result: Upon receiving the changed TSET setting, SRS-009 evaluates the current reported temperature (70.0) against updated bounds [65.0, 75.0], determines it falls within bounds, and outputs the temperature status to Determine H/C Mode (SRS-010).

test_cases.title: Reported temperature exactly at lower bound LO
test_cases.preconditions: Initialization file sets TSET = 70.0 and OD = 5.0, giving lower bound LO = 65.0.
steps: 1. Report a temperature value of exactly 65.0 degrees (LO).
2. Verify status transmission from SRS-009 to SRS-010.
test_cases.expected_result: The temperature falls on the lower overtemperature boundary LO; SRS-009 outputs the temperature status to Determine H/C Mode (SRS-010).

test_cases.title: Reported temperature exactly at upper bound UO
test_cases.preconditions: Initialization file sets TSET = 70.0 and OD = 5.0, giving upper bound UO = 75.0.
steps: 1. Report a temperature value of exactly 75.0 degrees (UO).
2. Verify status transmission from SRS-009 to SRS-010.
test_cases.expected_result: The temperature falls on the upper overtemperature boundary UO; SRS-009 outputs the temperature status to Determine H/C Mode (SRS-010).

test_cases.title: Reported temperature just below lower bound LO
test_cases.preconditions: Initialization file sets TSET = 70.0 and OD = 5.0 (LO = 65.0).
steps: 1. Report a temperature value of 64.9 degrees (just below LO).
2. Check if SRS-009 outputs overtemperature status to SRS-010 for this requirement.
test_cases.expected_result: The reported temperature falls below LO (outside overtemperature bounds); SRS-009 does not classify it as falling within the overtemperature bounds specified by THEMAS-REQ-D.

test_cases.title: Reported temperature just above upper bound UO
test_cases.preconditions: Initialization file sets TSET = 70.0 and OD = 5.0 (UO = 75.0).
steps: 1. Report a temperature value of 75.1 degrees (just above UO).
2. Check if SRS-009 outputs overtemperature status to SRS-010 for this requirement.
test_cases.expected_result: The reported temperature falls above UO (outside overtemperature bounds); SRS-009 does not classify it as falling within the overtemperature bounds specified by THEMAS-REQ-D.
